'''Head Chef''' was the title given to a [[Chef/Legends|chef]] who was in command of a large staff of individuals devoted to cooking and preparing [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]]. [[Chirome]] was the Head Chef aboard the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']].<ref name="RPG1" /> The [[Head Chef Droid]] served as Head Chef of [[The Sarlacc Pit]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] and [[Bog's Bounty Banquet Hall]] during the [[Feast of Prosperity/Legends|Feast of Prosperity]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] in [[3626 BBY]].<ref name="Feast">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20201016|text=Prepare For The Feast of Prosperity!}}</ref>
